import math
def control(obs):
    h=obs['hitch_deg']; th=math.radians(-h)
    cam=obs['views'].get('camera')
    if not cam: return (1.6*h,-0.5,-23)
    sides=[[],[]]
    for b,d in cam.get('walls',[]):
        a=math.radians(b); x=d*math.cos(a); y=d*math.sin(a)
        u=-math.cos(th)*x-math.sin(th)*y
        v=-math.sin(th)*x+math.cos(th)*y
        if 0.5<u<6.5: sides[v>0].append((u,v))
    estimates=[]
    for pts in sides:
        if not pts: continue
        pts=sorted(pts,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-3.0))[:5]
        w=[1/(0.3+(u-3)**2) for u,v in pts]
        sw=sum(w); mu=sum(q*p[0] for q,p in zip(w,pts))/sw; mv=sum(q*p[1] for q,p in zip(w,pts))/sw
        den=sum(q*(p[0]-mu)**2 for q,p in zip(w,pts))
        slope=sum(q*(p[0]-mu)*(p[1]-mv) for q,p in zip(w,pts))/max(den,0.01)
        estimates.append(mv+slope*(3-mu))
    error=sum(estimates)/2 if len(estimates)==2 else 0
    desired=max(-28,min(28,math.degrees(math.atan2(5.2*error,9))))
    steer=max(-34,min(34,2.0*h-1.3*desired))
    return (steer,-0.65,-23)
